title: Record a nonlethal melee knockout atomically for characters (rule:knocking-a-creature-out)
description:
Problem. SRD rule:knocking-a-creature-out: when an attacker reduces a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack it can choose, the instant the damage is dealt, to knock the creature out; 'the creature falls unconscious and is stable.' For a character, hpLifecycle.ts applyDamage turns damage beyond 0 that equals or exceeds the HP maximum into instant death (adjust_hp has no nonlethal option; healing the dead is refused), so the source-selected outcome is unrecordable in that case. (Below the overflow threshold adjust_hp -> dying, then stabilize_character, reaches the source state. Encounter combatants already accept status 'unconscious'.) Current disclosure: RULE_KNOWN_LIMITS rule:knocking-a-creature-out with capability gap 'nonlethal-knockout'.

Required capability. Operation: a nonlethal-knockout option on character damage application that, in one transaction, sets HP to 0, unconscious and stable (death-save counters reset, stable recovery deadline armed) without dying or the overflow instant-death branch. Inputs: character, damage amount, knockout flag. Exclusions: whether the attack was melee and whether the attacker chose to knock out (DM).

Selection basis: the governing SRD clause requires an engine-owned step (ADR 0020 §3: arithmetic / atomic state mutation / resource accounting / lifecycle), and no registered tool performs it. Under F-09 design amendment A5 (docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md, PR #596) the rule's known limit only DISCLOSES this gap; it does not satisfy or retire the obligation. This bead blocks eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4 (owning rules work for opus:F-09 / sol:CAP-001) until the capability lands or accepted authority explicitly changes the requirement. Do not close it because PR #596 recorded the gap. Enters this engine family by explicit positive selection (the family's out-of-backlog entry clause).
acceptance_criteria:
- Atomic nonlethal knockout path for characters, including when overflow would otherwise kill.
- Tests: overflow case, non-overflow case, concentration broken by unconsciousness, stable recovery armed.
- rule:knocking-a-creature-out known limit rewritten or retired under R0; gap entry removed.
- eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4 dependency resolves only when this lands.
